scope: Header-only prequalification of the fixed eight-root reference capability set on evidence distinct from invalid DOY251. No observation record, navigation product, target value, residual, inverse fit, orbit or S3 claim.

phase_transform_policy.rinex3_scale_factor: Divide stored observations by the declared SYS / SCALE FACTOR before use; missing means one.
phase_transform_policy.rinex3_phase_shift: Retain each declared additive cycle shift and satellite scope; a system-only blank declaration is unknown.
phase_transform_policy.legacy_wavelength_factor: Retain the L1/L2 ambiguity-wavelength divisor and satellite overrides. It does not rescale stored carrier cycles. Factor zero on a required band is fatal.
phase_transform_policy.lli: Every nonblank, nonzero LLI on either required phase field breaks a future contiguous segment; no opposite-factor or half-cycle state is admitted.
phase_transform_policy.applied_external_corrections: Nonblank GPS SYS / DCBS APPLIED or SYS / PCVS APPLIED remains unqualified without its independently frozen correction product.
phase_transform_policy.receiver_clock: RCV CLOCK OFFS APPL must be zero or absent.

supersedes_execution_only.reason: The frozen v1 parser misspelled the standard CRINEX VERS   / TYPE label and therefore never entered a RINEX header.
